item.title: The Exorcist VR Game Forced To Change Title After Losing License
item.description: Due to the license-holder not renewing it, The Exorcist: Legion VR has been forced to rename to Exorcism of the Legion (Last Rites).

item.title: Pico To Detail visionOS Competitor For New Headset Next Month
item.description: ByteDance's Pico will detail its competitor to visionOS, which will include a shared-space for 2D and spatial apps to run together, set to debut in its next headset.

item.title: Meta "Explicitly Separating" Horizon Worlds From Quest
item.description: Meta says it's "explicitly separating" Horizon Worlds from Quest, in a blog post assuring developers that it's still committed to the VR ecosystem.

item.title: ZIX Gets A 'Foundation'-al Update While Devs Announce New Free-To-Play Spinoff
item.description: Co-op roguelite ZIX got a huge update, while developer Hidden IO announced a new free-to-play spinoff to build its player base.

item.title: Quest's Horizon+ Reaches 1 Million Active Subscribers
item.description: Horizon+ hit over 1 million active subscribers in 2025, according to Meta, a significant shift in how many Quest owners access premium titles.

item.title: Peak Rhythm Combines Rhythm & Climbing On Quest Next Month
item.description: Peak Rhythm, a VR musical rhythm climbing game, launches in Early Access on Quest next month.

item.title: Hands-On: Birdseed Invites You To Relax & Photograph Cute Dumb Birds
item.description: Birdseed is a cozy VR game about photographing silly birds, and so far we simply love it.

item.title: Fish! In VRChat Feels Like A Mix Between Animal Crossing & Webfishing
item.description: If you've been craving a visit to a cluster of islands that feels like a mix of Animal Crossing and Webfishing, Fish! in VRChat is worth a look.

item.title: Blackgate Welcomes In 'Fresh Meat' with Alien Free Play Weekend
item.description: You can play the 4v1 zero-gravity survival horror game Blackgate as the paywalled alien for free right now until Monday.

item.title: Pirates VR: Jolly Roger Graphics Comparison - PC VR vs Quest
item.description: Pirates VR: Jolly Roger arrived on Quest 3 a year after releasing on PC VR. We compared the graphics to assess the state of standalone VR.
